title: Rethinking the design space of Vanilla Pixel Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: 重新思考朴素像素扩散Transformer的设计空间

paragraphs.en: MFlow提出自适应参数化在像素扩散Transformer中灵活插值x₀与速度预测，并用轻量ConvRefiner修复高频细节缺失，性能表现优异。 Pixel-space diffusion models have recently re-emerged as a compelling alternative to latent diffusion, avoiding the lossy latent bottleneck and separately trained autoencoder. JiT shows that a vanilla diffusion transformer can generate directly in pixel space by replacing the commonly used velocity prediction ($\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction) with clean image prediction ($\boldsymbol{x_0}$-prediction). In this work, we revisit this choice and introduce MFlow, an adaptive parameterization that learns to interpolate between $\boldsymbol{x_0}$- and $\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction across principal directions of the data, learned end-to-end with diffusion training. We find that the preferred parameterization varies systematically with the data representation and model capacity -- notably, increasing model capacity shifts preference toward velocity prediction. We evaluate MFlow across ImageNet, UCF-101 video, and large-scale text-to-image generation, demonstrating competitive or improved generative performance across diverse settings. In addition, we find that vanilla pixel diffusion transformers, irrespective of parameterization, retain a persistent high-frequency deficit relative to real images. To address this, we introduce ConvRefiner, a lightweight convolutional module trained post-hoc with an adversarial loss while keeping the diffusion backbone frozen. With only a small amount of additional training, ConvRefiner restores the high-frequency statistics of generated images while preserving FID. Project webpage: https://soumik-kanad.github.io/mflow-diffusion/.
paragraphs.zh: MFlow提出一种自适应参数化方法，可在像素扩散Transformer中灵活地在x₀预测与速度预测之间插值，并用轻量的ConvRefiner修复高频细节缺失，性能表现优异。像素空间的扩散模型近来重新成为一种有吸引力的潜在扩散替代方案，它避免了有损的潜在瓶颈以及单独训练的自编码器。 JiT表明，一个原生的扩散Transformer可以直接在像素空间中生成，只需将常用的速度预测（$\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction）替换为干净图像预测（$\boldsymbol{x_0}$-prediction）。 在本工作中，我们重新审视这一选择，并提出MFlow，这是一种自适应参数化，它学习在数据的主方向上于$\boldsymbol{x_0}$-prediction和$\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction之间进行插值，并通过扩散训练端到端地学习得到。 我们发现，偏好哪种参数化会随数据表示和模型容量而系统性地变化——值得注意的是，增加模型容量会使偏好转向速度预测。 我们在ImageNet、UCF-101视频以及大规模文生图生成上评估了MFlow，展示了在多种设置下具有竞争力或更优的生成性能。 此外，我们发现原生的像素扩散Transformer，无论采用何种参数化，相比真实图像都持续存在高频缺失问题。 为解决这一问题，我们提出ConvRefiner，一个轻量的卷积模块，它在扩散主干保持冻结的情况下，事后通过对抗损失进行训练。 ConvRefiner仅需少量额外训练，即可在保持FID的同时恢复生成图像的高频统计特性。 项目网页：https://soumik-kanad.github.io/mflow-diffusion/。
